title: Medtrum Nano / Extended Bolus
body:
Hello,

as written in the Docs, there is currently no way to use "Extended Bolus" with the Medtrum Nano Pump.

https://androidaps.readthedocs.io/de/latest/CompatiblePumps/MedtrumNano.html

I'm aware, that Extended Bolus is not deeply needed for Close-Loop, but there are situations (as high-fat carbs), where it would be helpful.

Is this a restriction from the pump itself or is it simply not integrated in AAPS yet?

Thanks in advance
Michael

comments.body:
Extended boluses cannot be used with closed loop. thus probably not implemented in Medtrum at all
use eCarbs instead
